why_ai: Platform operations are software and models; real-time moderation and fraud keep some human judgment.
why_clarity: GMV and conversion register within seconds of a host's pitch, though discovery methods are improvised.
why_digital: Streams, ranking and checkout are online, though the goods sold are physical.

why_ai: Ranking new streams from priors and early signal is a recommendation model.
why_clarity: Every stream repeats the cold start, and viewer and purchase response arrives within minutes.
why_digital: Stream metadata and early engagement in, rankings out.

why_ai: Settling contention for one unit is mechanical allocation and settlement engineering.
why_clarity: Each drop either sells exactly once without overselling or stalling, verified instantly.
why_digital: Concurrent purchase claims processed entirely in checkout software.

why_ai: Finding, combining and packing uncatalogued one-off items is hands-on work in sellers' spaces.
why_clarity: Each buyer's purchases go into one correct parcel, hundreds of times per show.
why_digital: Uncatalogued physical items packed by hand and shipped as parcels.

why_ai: Changing the ranking objective from watch time to purchase is a model retraining problem.
why_clarity: Purchases are an objective target logged against every recommendation in near real time.
why_digital: Viewer behaviour and purchase logs in, ranked streams out.

why_ai: Streaming classification of video, audio and chat is a latency-bound model task.
why_clarity: Constant classification volume, but policy boundaries for violations are fuzzy.
why_digital: Live video, audio and chat streams classified in software.

why_ai: Vision models can capture and describe items once sellers hold them to a camera.
why_clarity: Each item needs a listing with description and comparable price, repeated thousands of times.
why_digital: Starts from physical stock in boxes; ends as online listings.

why_ai: Mining aligned video, speech and purchase records is analytics software on a complete corpus.
why_clarity: Purchases are logged per second, but what a host should do next is advisory.
why_digital: Second-by-second show records in, host recommendations out.

why_ai: Matching viewers to live streams is a ranking system, the core product of platform engineering.
why_clarity: Every session repeats the matching, with watch and purchase response arriving in minutes.
why_digital: Stream and viewer data in, ranked feeds out.

why_ai: Viewers follow a specific personality, though AI avatar hosts and automation erode the mechanical load.
why_clarity: Sales land instantly on screen, but selling on camera is performance done by feel.
why_digital: Physical products held up to a camera, sold through an online stream.

why_ai: Irreversible four-second calls on someone's income keep humans in the loop, assisted by classifiers.
why_clarity: Policy guides repeated calls, but there is no feedback on whether a cut-off was correct.
why_digital: Moderators watch concurrent live streams and act on screen.
